name: accounts-core
description: Accounts-core: the shared user accounts module every G-ynthetic Labs product pins. Accounts kept on the person's own computer, sign-in sessions, passwords, magic links and disclosed, aggregate-only telemetry. SIMULATED until the owner's word. G-ynthetic Labs, internal.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run map -- --check && npm run legal -- check && npm run keys && npm run markers && npm test

x-dependencies: No outside packages at run time: the packages use Node's own crypto, and telemetry reads the probe contract from the company's adapter library (vendor/adapter-lib, pinned submodule, itself dependency-free). typescript (7) is the type check; typescript-api (TypeScript 6.0) is the code map's parser until TypeScript 7 ships a stable parser API.
